title: B-tree cell-size cache compute and lookup accessors

scope.rationale: computeCellSize and cachedCellSize jointly own lazy population and reuse of one CellArray size slot. Keeping them together preserves the source zero-sentinel contract and the single computation path used by page rebuild and balance planning.
excluded_responsibilities: Cell payload parsing and local/overflow size calculation
Page rebuild, edit, and balance ownership

external_source_responsibilities: CellArray supplies aligned cell and size slices
Page cell-size owner computes the source-equivalent size for one cell
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete source accessor bodies are assigned. populateCellCache routes empty slots through computeCellSize; direct lazy callers use cachedCellSize.

outputs: Exact cell size and a populated size slot when it was previously zero
contracts.ownership: Borrowed page/cell slices; only the indexed cache slot is mutated.
contracts.state_and_results: computeCellSize requires a zero slot, computes once, stores, and returns it. cachedCellSize returns a nonzero slot unchanged or delegates to computeCellSize.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, allocation, or I/O. B-tree owner synchronization is external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Source assertions become Range or Corrupt for malformed typed input; a successful cache write remains reusable.

representation_differences: Source u16 slots are usize slots in the bounded typed CellArray; page geometry constrains successful values while avoiding truncation in intermediate native logic.
Source assertions become explicit Range/Corrupt errors at the Zig boundary.

oracle.protocol: Create one interior cell with an empty size slot, call cachedCellSize and require exact storage, call it again and require the cached value, reject direct recomputation of a nonzero slot, then clear and repopulate through populateCellCache.
internal_observations: size slot before and after first lookup
second lookup result without slot mutation
oracle.normalization: Compare exact nonzero integer sizes and typed error classes.

assurance.malformed_input: Bounds, slice alignment, and zero-slot preconditions return typed errors.
assurance.continuation: Successful cached state is reusable; failed preconditions do not mutate it.
assurance.performance: Constant-time cache hit; one bounded cell-size parse on miss.

integration.native_call_path: populateCellCache consumes computeCellSize for empty entries; cachedCellSize is available to rebuild and balance callers and covered in the owner trace.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline empty-slot computation in populateCellCache is retired in favor of the source-shaped compute accessor.

independent_review.notes: Requires full rebuild/balance integration, pinned-C cache trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Route native rebuild/edit/balance size queries through cachedCellSize.
